summary: Comprehensive backend API testing of SHG BANK app. All 43 pytest tests passed across auth, members, loans (calculator/apply/approve/reject/recall/emi-pay), contributions (single+bulk), settings, savings, password change/reset, dashboard stats, member stats, defaulters, and CSV export. Penalty calculation, loan eligibility (50% rule), max-loan/months validation and admin authorization checks all working as expected.

minor.issue: Returns success even when loan_id does not exist (no 404). Silent no-op.
Same as approve - no 404 on missing loan.
No balance check; can withdraw more than deposit, creating negative balance. Also crashes (500) if memberId not found because find_one returns None and code accesses member['name'].
Same NoneType crash if invalid memberId is supplied (no member existence validation).
Returns JSON {csv: '...'} rather than proper text/csv response with Content-Disposition attachment. Frontend will have to handle string download.
Allows admin/member to change mobile to an already-existing mobile (no uniqueness check). Could break login uniqueness.

action_items: Hash passwords (bcrypt) - currently stored plain-text in Mongo (security CRITICAL).
Use signed JWT or random session tokens instead of raw memberId as bearer token (currently anyone who knows/guesses a member UUID can impersonate them).
Add 404 handling to loan approve/reject when loan_id not found.
Validate memberId existence in /api/savings/deposit and /api/savings/withdraw (currently 500 on bad id).
Add balance check in /api/savings/withdraw to prevent negative balance.
Make /api/csv/all return proper text/csv Response with Content-Disposition header instead of JSON wrapping.
Enforce mobile uniqueness on PUT /api/members/{id} (currently no check).
Dead code in apply_loan: 'closing = ... if False else now' ternary is unused (cosmetic cleanup).
Consider configurable test_database vs prod DB_NAME - currently DB_NAME=test_database for production-like preview.
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY: Passwords stored as plaintext in MongoDB (Member.password). Use bcrypt/argon2.
SECURITY: Bearer token = raw memberId UUID. No signature/expiry. Replace with JWT or session token table.
Penalty calc uses math.ceil(seconds/86400) so partial day rounds up; harmless for ₹10/day but document the rule.
Loan apply_loan has unused dead-code ternary (line 450-451) with 'if False else now'.
savings_deposit/withdraw don't validate memberId -> NoneType subscript will 500.
loan_approve/reject don't check existence -> silently succeed even for invalid IDs.
Missing input validation on Contribution month format (e.g., '2025-13' would be accepted and break datetime ops).
No rate-limit / brute-force protection on /api/auth/login (mobile + 4-digit pwd = 10k combos).
seed_data_creation: Tests created persistent data: contributions for NISHA (2025-09, 2025-10) + bulk for 2025-11 across 3 members, 1 active loan ₹3000/2mo for NISHA with EMI#1 paid, savings deposit ₹500 + withdraw ₹200 for NISHA. These will affect subsequent runs / frontend tests as state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs verified working. Test data is persisted in MongoDB (test_database). NISHA has 3 contributions + 1 active loan with 1/2 EMI paid + savings balance ₹300. If frontend tests need a clean state, drop relevant collections or re-seed. Token is raw memberId UUID - use directly as Bearer. Backend hot-reloads via supervisor.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs blocking. Minor issues documented above.
